title: C2PA Manifest Composer
description: Authors a C2PA manifest DEFINITION in-browser: c2pa.actions v2 assertions with a digitalSourceType picker (including trainedAlgorithmicMedia), ingredient declarations with client-side sha256 digests, a creative-work/EXIF-subset assertion, and a draft CAWG identity block. Composes and structurally validates only; never signs and makes no Trust List claims. Also exports a c2patool-compatible manifest-definition file so users can sign externally with their own certificate and tooling.

ingredients.description: Ingredient declarations; hash is a client-side sha256 of the dropped file

exif_subset.description: Make, Model, Software, DateTimeOriginal only — no location fields

cawg_identity.description: Draft CAWG Identity Assertion v1.3 shape, unsigned, unverified

intended_signature_alg.description: Declared intent only (ES256/Ed25519/PS256) — never an actual signature

definition_digest.description: sha256 digest of the definition, computed client-side

structural_validation.description: manifest_valid, has_hard_binding, has_actions, missing_elements — same checks as art-123-c2pa-manifest-validator

c2patool_definition.description: Same definition remapped to c2patool's documented manifest JSON field names (claim_generator, title, format, instanceId, assertions) for external signing — never signed by this tool

mcp_tool_definition.name: compose_c2pa_manifest_definition
mcp_tool_definition.description: Composes a C2PA manifest DEFINITION from declared actions (c2pa.actions.v2, with digitalSourceType including trainedAlgorithmicMedia), ingredient declarations with client-side sha256 digests, a creative-work/EXIF-subset assertion, and an optional draft CAWG identity block. Runs the same structural validation as the house C2PA manifest validator. Does not sign and makes no Trust List claims — the output is a definition for external signing, not a signed manifest. Also exports a c2patool-compatible manifest-definition file for signing with your own certificate and tooling. Browser-based, client-side only, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/550-c2pa-manifest-composer.html for interactive use.
